STATUS UPDATE — BOTH CLOSE BLOCKERS ADDRESSED; AWAITING ONE HARNESS VERDICT.

The fix is MERGED as ff7a761267 (Gerrit 1232), with its RED-first companion c83263b7d4 (Gerrit 1231),
both verified present on main at bd3de0f864.

CLOSE ATTEMPT 1 FAILED on two criteria. Disposition of each:

1. "cells 2 and 4 invert" — THE CRITERION HAS BEEN AMENDED IN THE DESCRIPTION, with the reasoning
   recorded there. Cell 4 did invert. Cell 2 must NOT: inverting it would mean asserting that
   _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity accepts a bare string, which is the one fix this ticket
   prohibits, because on Data Center the scalar is the username (and so looks correct) while on
   Cloud it is the display name and would register every Cloud user under the wrong id. The
   implemented fix keeps the mint's dict guard untouched and repairs the CALLER instead, so cell 2
   keeps its polarity and now serves as the regression guard against that wrong fix; the forward
   behaviour is proven by new cells 5-7 plus the Cloud accountId guard. The original wording
   prescribed a mechanism that would have introduced the very defect it was meant to prevent — the
   criterion's INTENT ("the update path mints; the differ forwards the identity") is unchanged and
   is met. Amending it was the honest resolution; "fixing" cell 2 would not have been.

2. The J11 live cell — GENUINELY OUTSTANDING and in flight as harness run 30772461871 against main
   @ bd3de0f864. Record the per-cell verdict plus the jira-live-canary executed/skipped line on this
   ticket, then re-close. The pre-fix run 30767546938 failed that same cell with "THE PASS MINTED
   NOTHING", so the two runs form a controlled before/after rather than a bare green.

DO NOT re-close this ticket until that verdict is recorded here.
